note: BH-8497. The GitHub-Issues board fingerprint (bin/triage-gate.sh fetch_fingerprint) reads every page of open ai-build issues (100 per page, each page with its own ETag) up to this many pages, and no closed issue (a closed blocker resolves through refs.json). A full last page is a cap hit: the rows read are used and ONE ALERTS line per project per UTC day names the project and the count read (never on --seed). Read by tbp_max_pages as ${TRIAGE_STATE_BOARD_MAX_PAGES:-20}; junk is 20, clamped to 1..100. Rows: lib.triage-state.<project>.triage_state_board_max_pages, then lib.triage-state.triage_state_board_max_pages.
